profile.title: My profile
profile.biographyHint: Stored exactly as you write it, and never translated.

rates.title: Rates
rates.perHeadHint: What one family pays. This is the figure a parent compares.
rates.travelHint: Added on top for home visits. Leave blank if none.
rates.rupeesOnly: Whole rupees. No decimals, no commas.
rates.negotiableHint: Families see that you are open to discussing it.
rates.previewPending: Fill in the amount and we will show you the hourly equivalent.
rates.previewNote: This is the figure used to compare you with other tutors. It is not what you charge.
rates.emptyBody: Add at least one rate so families know what an arrangement with you costs.
rates.whyTitle: Why we show an hourly figure
rates.whyBody: Tuition in Pakistan is quoted four different ways, and a family comparing a monthly fee against a per-session fee cannot tell which is cheaper. So we convert every rate the same way and show the result. You still charge exactly what you set.
rates.whyExample: A monthly fee of {{monthly}} for three ninety-minute sessions a week works out at about {{hourly}} an hour.
rates.whyWeeks: A month is counted as {{weeks}} weeks, so the figure does not jump between a four-week and a five-week month.

safety.enforcedBody: When you set a condition here, the system refuses any booking that breaks it. A family cannot request a session that contradicts what you have set, and you will not be asked to decline one.
safety.noPenaltyBody: Declines you make under these conditions are excluded from your confirmation rate. Setting them costs you nothing in how you appear to families.
safety.femaleOnlyHint: Requests for male students will not reach you.
safety.guardianHint: The family is told this before they book, and confirms it as part of the request.
safety.restrictedAreas: Areas I will not travel to
safety.restrictedHint: Home-visit requests from these areas will not reach you. You do not have to give a reason.
safety.restrictedPlaceholder: Search for an area to exclude
safety.noRestrictedAreas: You have not excluded any areas.
safety.summaryFemaleOnly: Only female students may book you.
safety.summaryGuardian: Every booking requires a guardian to be present.
safety.summaryAreas_one: One area is excluded from home visits.
safety.summaryAreas_other: {{count}} areas are excluded from home visits.
safety.noneSet: No conditions set. You will receive every request that matches your subjects and availability.

explain.draft: Nobody has seen this yet. Complete the items below and submit when you are ready.
explain.pending_verification: An administrator will check your documents. You do not need to do anything.
explain.documents_submitted: Your documents have arrived and are in the queue.
explain.under_review: An administrator is reading your documents now.
explain.approved: Your profile is searchable. Families can find you and request bookings.
explain.rejected: Your profile is not searchable. The reason is below, and you can appeal.
explain.more_info_needed: An administrator needs something more before deciding. The details are below.

verification.cannotSubmit_one: One thing is still needed before you can submit
verification.cannotSubmit_other: {{count}} things are still needed before you can submit
verification.notChecked: No police or background check is performed. Your badge says exactly what was checked and nothing more.
verification.appealBody: An administrator will read your appeal and can overturn the decision. You may appeal once, after seven days.
verification.historyNote: Every decision is kept. A later one replaces an earlier one without erasing it.

explain.asserted: You have told us you teach this. Nobody has tested it yet, and families see it described exactly that way.
explain.under_assessment: The assessment has started. Your badge appears only if you pass.
explain.failed: This topic was assessed and not passed. You keep the claim, and you may appeal or re-sit after the cooling period.
explain.expired: This badge has lapsed after twelve months. You remain listed; the badge returns when you re-sit.
explain.appealed: Your appeal is with an administrator.

claims.verifiedExplain: Assessed on {{date}} and valid until {{expires}}. Families see the topic named, never a general claim about the subject.
claims.untestedTitle_one: One claim has not been tested
claims.untestedBody: An untested claim is shown to families as something you said about yourself, not as something we checked. Sitting the assessment is what turns it into a badge.
claims.emptyBody: Tell us what you teach — subject, level and board. You will not be searchable until you claim at least one.
claims.assertedNote: These are her own statements. They have not been assessed, and Ustaad.com does not present them as verified.

availability.caption: Your weekly availability
availability.modeForNew: How you will teach these slots
availability.modeHint: Applies to the blocks you tap next. You can mix modes across the week.
availability.areaHint: Only for slots where you travel.
availability.emptyHint: Tap the blocks when you are free. Tap again to remove one.

documents.privacyBody: They are stored in a private area that no search engine and no visitor can reach. They never appear on your profile.
documents.privacyAccess: Only an administrator can open them, only through a link that expires within minutes, and every time one is opened it is recorded against the administrator who did it.
documents.whoSees: Seen by: administrators only, during verification. Never by families, never by other tutors.

cnic_front.title: CNIC — front
cnic_front.purpose: Confirms you are who you say you are. The number itself is never stored in a form anyone can search.

cnic_back.title: CNIC — back
cnic_back.purpose: Confirms the card is genuine and current.

degree.title: Degree certificate
degree.purpose: Supports the subjects and levels you claim to teach.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.purpose: Optional. Helps where a degree title does not name the subject you teach.

documents.accepted: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to {{max}} MB.
documents.errorTooLarge: That file is larger than {{max}} MB. A photograph taken on a phone is usually well under it.
documents.errorType: That file type is not accepted. Use a JPG, PNG or PDF.
documents.errorMismatch: That file says it is a {{type}} but its name does not match. Save it again and retry.
